info.description: RSS feed aggregator with passkey authentication.
info.title: GKFeed API

post.description: Adds a new RSS/YouTube/TikTok feed for the authenticated user.
Creates a feed by parsing the URL and detecting the source type (YouTube, TikTok, Rezka, etc.).

get.description: Returns all registered passkeys for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Removes a specific passkey credential for the authenticated user.

post.description: Starts discoverable WebAuthn login, returns assertion options for the browser.
Completes WebAuthn authentication, returns an access/refresh token pair.
Revokes the refresh-token family associated with the supplied token.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's ID and name.

post.description: Rotates a refresh token and returns a new access/refresh token pair.
Starts WebAuthn registration, returns creation options for the browser.
Completes WebAuthn registration with the attestation response from the browser.

delete.description: Deletes a feed by ID. Only the feed owner can delete it.

get.description: Returns all user items as an RSS 2.0 XML feed.
Returns all feed type identifiers supported by the parser.
Returns paginated items for the authenticated user. Supports cursor-based pagination.
Returns a single item with its parent feed for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an item owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all feeds for the authenticated user.
Returns the authenticated user's feeds. An empty list is returned as [].

post.description: Resolves missing metadata and creates all selected subscriptions atomically. Explicit type or types overrides automatic selection. Repeats return existing feeds without changing them.
post.summary: Create subscriptions from a source URL

parameters.description: One source URL, optional title and either type or types
parameters.name: feed
